name: LongBench-Cite
description: LongBench-Cite is an automated benchmark for evaluating long-context question answering with fine-grained sentence-level citations, aiming to improve faithfulness and verifiability of long-context LLM responses.
reputation: A newer long-context citation benchmark that is gaining attention for faithfulness and verifiability evaluation, but is not yet as widely adopted as established long-context QA suites.
notes: Includes a large-scale SFT dataset LongCite-45k and models trained on it; benchmark reveals room for improvement in citation quality.
